Today I tried teeth whitening at Wink Clinic.
Actually, I've never had a dental checkup before because I've never had any pain, just slight sensitivity.
Before the checkup, the clinic advised that I should get a tartar removal first. During the checkup, they found one cavity and three holes. I was worried, so I had the dentist take care of it right away (the dentist also gave me a general dental checkup). Then I proceeded with the teeth whitening program.
The price wasn't expensive at all, only 3499 baht, and the results were great. My teeth are really whiter (several shades lighter, from very yellow to pure white). The dentist explained how long the results would last, no secrets withheld. The dentist said that if I wanted them to be even whiter, I could come back in two months, but that might not be convenient for me as I live in another province. But if I have the chance, I'll definitely come back again.
